kb_quartermaster: Everything on these shelves had to be carried down through the crack in the roof, so it costs a bit more than it would up top. If you're heading out into the cavern, I've got what you'll need.
kb_trader: I buy what comes out of the cavern and send it up to the surface, and I sell what comes down. Crystal and fungus sell well up top, if you've got any.
kb_smith: There's no good coal down here, so I burn whatever the Codex says it can spare. The forge still gets hot enough. I can sell you plans and supplies, or fix what you're wearing.
kb_reagent_seller: Everything here is labelled with where it was picked and when. If you need reagents for spells or for brewing, ask me and I'll find them.
kb_innkeeper: There's no day or night down here, so we picked hours and stick to them. Supper is whenever you get in. Sit down and I'll bring you something.
kb_alchemist: Herbs picked down here test stronger than the same herbs picked on the surface. I don't know why yet, but it makes for good potions, and I've got plenty of them.
